summary: Every requirement and ruling in the plan maps to a done phase with a landed commit matching the sweep (P1 srviac probe; P2 pod/node/LoadBalancer rules; P3 OIDC blackbox and DHCP alerts; P3a/P4 healthchecks.io element and heartbeat; P5/P6 reader user, ExternalSecret, spec-hashed Job name and README rotation path; P7 runbook route). The V items not yet settled (V02, V08, V14) are owed to the operator's srviac apply and healthchecks.io drill, which close-out A3-A5 track. V10's live confirmation and the push order belong to the test phase, which the done-records brief. No done-record admits a leftover the close-out lacks: B1-B3, D1, P1 and T1 cover the reviewers' sub-bar findings, and none is owed work that clears the bar for a phase. I noted on B2 that it bears on V14's dry-run clause.
